label: Four sk-vision vision-runtime test files sit beside their sources inside src/ (plugin.test.ts, runtime/client.test.ts, opencode/tools.test.ts, opencode/attachments.test.ts), against the universal rule that a test never sits beside its source and tests live in the package's top-level tests/ tree; vitest discovery still finds them, so coverage exists but the placement convention is missed.

sk-doc's frontmatter-version tests keep the legacy test- prefix (test-frontmatter-version.mjs, test-frontmatter-version-bump.mjs) and are mounted in no runner: run-node-tests.mjs discovers only *.test.mjs/*.test.cjs under its five ROOTS and sk-doc's run-script-tests.sh loops only test_*.py, so commit e87ea715ed (+29 test lines) extended a test file nothing executes; the file self-documents a manual node invocation, and the live Node convention is *.test.mjs.

hooks/opencode/sk-vision.ts, the OpenCode host adapter modified in-window by a8846ad07c to wire RuntimeClient and skVisionTools, has no paired test; vision-runtime's tests cover tools, client, plugin and attachments but nothing exercises the adapter's registration wiring.

.pi/extensions is absent from run-node-tests.mjs ROOTS, so the pi-fast-mode and pi session-relaunch vitest suites run only via their own package.json scripts and the central Node runner is blind to them; a dedicated adapter-suite runner may invoke them separately, unconfirmed this iteration.

run-all-drift-guards.sh, the single-entry drift-gate orchestrator changed in-window, ships without a test of its own; its PASS/FAIL aggregation and warning accounting were verified only by execution in this iteration (all four guards PASS, 10 non-blocking warnings, none on changed files).

opencode.json was changed by 095ddd7246 (default OpenCode to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at max effort); its conformance with sk-code-skilled's config standards was not assessed in this code-file-scoped iteration and remains UNKNOWN.

Comment-hygiene HARD BLOCK holds across all 77 changed code files (check-comment-hygiene.sh exit 0, zero violations, zero hygiene-ok escapes) and all four shipped sk-code drift guards PASS at HEAD; every sampled changed file carries the guide-exact MODULE header (70-char header, 80-char section dividers), no new file introduces the deprecated box-drawing header, all runtime mirrors are byte-identical to their .skilled sources with a parity test shipped in the same window, and the sk-code-skilled rename is fully propagated (doc-claims names check passes).

reason: Its branch side contains only the trigger-index rebuild (0743e52560); merge-base diff 8e8e95e8e6..0743e52560 yields no code files outside fixtures, so the adapter-suite-runner effort contributes no code to the conformance surface.
